learningGoals: Identify and name the four main seasons: Summer, Monsoon, Winter, and Spring. 🌍
Understand how the weather changes in each season. 🌦️
Recognize the different clothes we wear and the food we eat during different times of the year. 🧥🍉
Develop a love for nature by observing how plants and trees change with the seasons. 🌱
teachingTips: Talk to your child about the current weather outside and ask them which season they think it is right now. 🌤️
While dressing up, explain why we wear specific clothes, like cotton in summer and wool in winter, to help them connect clothes to seasons. 🧣
Relate seasons to their favorite seasonal fruits and vegetables, like mangoes in summer or carrots in winter! 🥭🥕
Read the poem or story in the chapter together with excitement, using actions for shivering in winter or fanning yourself in summer. 🎭

funActivities.title: Season Sorting Game 🧺
funActivities.description: Gather a mix of summer clothes (t-shirts, sunglasses) and winter clothes (sweaters, caps). Ask your child to sort them into a 'Hot Weather' pile and a 'Cold Weather' pile! 👕🧤

funActivities.title: My Favorite Season Drawing 🎨
funActivities.description: Give your child a blank paper and crayons. Ask them to draw their favorite season. If they love monsoon, they can draw a big colorful umbrella and blue raindrops! ☔

funActivities.title: Weather Walk 🚶‍♀️
funActivities.description: Take a short walk outside or look out the balcony. Point out the sky, the trees, and the wind. Discuss whether it feels sunny, rainy, or chilly today. 🌳
